latest.title: ¿Qué hace realmente un Data Engineer?
latest.description:
En esta publicación explico el papel del Data Engineer y cómo participa en todo el ciclo de vida de los datos: extracción, transformación, almacenamiento, procesamiento y preparación para Analytics, BI y Machine Learning.

También comparto cómo tecnologías como Python, SQL, AWS y otras herramientas forman parte de este ecosistema.

Si estás aprendiendo Data Engineering, me gustaría conocer tu experiencia.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Agent Challenge: Codice
latest.description: Códice is an autonomous agent that draws one page a day. Every morning it wakes on a schedule, reads the real sky over Mexico City — temperature, wind, cloud cover, rain, the length of the day, the phase of the moon — turns that reading into a visual language, draws an original SVG page, checks its own work, and publishes it to a gallery. Nobody triggers it. Nobody prompts it. When you come back, the page is already there, and it is a page that did not exist yesterday and cannot exist again tomorrow.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Agent Challenge: MemePulse
latest.description: An autonomous serverless agent that transforms daily trending tech news into visual AI memes using Amazon Bedrock and AWS Lambda. It automatically updates a public gallery every 24 hours without human intervention.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Agent Challenge: TheWalkingGhost - My Personal AI Assistant
latest.description:
TheWalkingGhost is my personal AI assistant built to solve my chaos of juggling cloud projects, biotech work, events, and academic deadlines. It syncs Blackboard deadlines automatically, manages my calendar through natural language, drafts emails when I am busy, sends WhatsApp reminders for critical deadlines, and provides daily morning briefings. Built with Streamlit, LangGraph, Groq API, and Supabase. Deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with Docker and ECR.

latest.title: What AWS's New Student Rewards Program Actually Means If You're Studying in South Africa
latest.description: AWS just rolled out Student Rewards on Builder Center, giving verified students a chunk of free AWS Credits, a year of premium Skill Builder access, and a voucher for a Foundational certification exam given you obtain a certain number of badges. On paper it's a great deal, and the headline number being thrown around is over $500 million in resources globally. But most of the coverage so far is written from a US-campus vantage point. Here's what it looks like from a tech degree in South Africa.

latest.title: Building a NOC Monitoring Lab on AWS with Zabbix
latest.description: Learn how I built a small Network Operations Center (NOC) lab on AWS using Amazon EC2, Zabbix 7.4, PostgreSQL, and Zabbix Agent 2 to monitor Linux infrastructure and simulate real-world incidents.

latest.title: Do Datalake ao Chatbot: Simplificando pipelines de RAG na AWS com Amazon S3, AWS Glue e Amazon Bedrock.
latest.description: Muitas soluções de IA Generativa falham por falta de contexto corporativo. Neste artigo, abordamos a perspectiva da Engenharia de Dados sobre como construir um pipeline de Recuperação Aumentada de Geração (RAG) robusto e escalável na AWS. Saiba como conectar seus dados armazenados no S3 ao Amazon Bedrock, utilizando o AWS Glue para a preparação, orquestração e criação de embeddings inteligentes que potencializam as respostas dos LLMs.

trending.title: Building OptiDB AI: Understanding PostgreSQL Query Plan Analysis
trending.description: OptiDB AI explores automated PostgreSQL query performance analysis by examining execution plans. It uses Spring Boot to capture query plans, FastAPI and Python to analyze them, and rule based detection to identify issues such as inefficient sequential scans, row estimation errors, and disk based sorts. An AI layer is being developed to help rank and explain findings while keeping the underlying analysis traceable.
